No specific medicine to treat it, so mostly it's about managing symptoms at home with rest and fluids.

nodes.author: Garima
nodes.text: This case was detected in a private hospital in Bengaluru, specifically at Baptist Hospital in the northern part of the city. The Karnataka health department confirmed the case but mentioned that they did not test the sample themselves as the report came from the private hospital. This marks the first known instance of HMPV in the city, and the state health department has stated there's no reason to doubt the private hospital's test results.
